acip: DE LTA NA MUN PAS RANG GIS RANG SGRIB PAR 'GYUR LA, DE 'DOD NA MUN KHUNG DU BUM PA MI MTHONG BA BZHIN DU, MUN PA YANG MI MTHONG BAR 'GYUR RO,,
wylie: de lta na mun pas rang gis rang sgrib par 'gyur la, de 'dod na mun khung du bum pa mi mthong ba bzhin du, mun pa yang mi mthong bar 'gyur ro
english: In that case then, darkness would also obscure itself, by itself. And if you agree to that, then you'd have to say that in a dark room we would not be able to see the darkness; just as in that same place we are unable to see a vase that is standing there.
